image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a modern steam iron against a white background. The iron features a blue and black plastic body with a translucent water tank section near the handle. The soleplate is metallic silver with a blue accent strip along the side. A temperature dial is visible on the top surface. The handle is ergonomic, curving over the body. No power cord is clearly visible extending from the rear in this cropped view.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The internal structure of the water tank appears slightly muddy and lacks the crisp refraction expected of clear plastic, suggesting minor generative softness.
The junction where the handle meets the main body, particularly near the rear, appears slightly fused or ill-defined, lacking a sharp mechanical seam.
The edge of the soleplate has a slight halo/softness rather than a sharp geometric boundary, common in AI generations.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of iron and rule out misclassification as similar appliances (e.g., garment steamer).
To verify the 3D coherence of the handle and body, ensuring the handle is properly attached and not floating or melting into the body.
To check for clean boundaries between the metal soleplate and plastic body, detecting any bleeding or fusion artifacts.
To assess overall texture quality, especially the translucency of the water tank and reflections on the metal.

focus_areas: Water tank translucency and internal detail
Presence and clarity of control dial markings
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'translucent' parts of the iron. AI often struggles with rendering clear plastic/water tanks correctly, often making them look opaque or muddy. Also, verify if the dial markings are gibberish or legible numbers/symbols, as this is a common failure mode for text-heavy controls on appliances.
